assets.label: Первый звонок — без ответа
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished standalone 16:9 landscape narrative game illustration as a two-panel phone-call split screen, divided into equal left and right halves by a very narrow dark vertical seam. Not a screenshot, no app chrome, no captions, no speech balloons, no watermark. Reference 1 = authoritative protagonist FACE, AGE, BUILD and WARDROBE. Reference 2 = exact residential bench LOCATION and current approved game rendering. Reference 3 = established game LIGHTING balance, painterly detail and palette only; do not copy its downtown square, sleeping stranger or wet pavement. Match the same realistic painterly illustration, restrained detail, quietly sad everyday atmosphere, readable skin and garment detail, cool slate blue-gray and charcoal shadows with soft localized cream/amber practical lights. Moderate saturation, neither orange/gold glossy grading nor excessively dark gray wash. Night at about 22:00 in autumn Warsaw. LEFT HALF in all three call images: the same 35-40-year-old man from ref 1, wavy dark-brown hair, short stubble, long straight nose, hazel eyes, charcoal hooded jacket, dark sweater, blue jeans. He sits on the SAME ordinary residential bench from ref 2, with exactly ONE black backpack beside him, holding a modest black smartphone to his ear with one naturally drawn hand. Clearly recognizable three-quarter face and upper body with enough bench and apartment windows visible to establish place. Tired and vulnerable, restrained expression, no tears or exaggerated despair, reasonably clean ordinary clothes. Keep the person large enough to read at mobile event-header size. Each half should feel like a cinematic crop of the same game world, with comparable clarity, not mismatched photo styles. Both people face generally inward toward the center but are clearly in separate places. Natural anatomy and correct phone grip, no extra fingers, no duplicate people or backpacks.
SCENE: The university acquaintance does not answer. LEFT: protagonist is listening to the ringing, waiting with a faint tense hope, seated on his residential bench. RIGHT HALF: an empty softly textured charcoal/slate dark field, quietly shaded, with exactly THREE small muted pale-gray dots in a horizontal row at its center. The dots are plain solid circles, understated, not glowing buttons or a text message bubble. No person, no imagined room, no avatar, no question mark, no lettering or phone UI on the right. The empty half represents silence and absence of a connection, not a revealed location. The left remains a rich readable illustration; the right deliberately quiet and empty.

RIGHT HALF: a DIFFERENT acquaintance, an ordinary man in his late thirties/early forties, short receding dark hair, thin dark rectangular glasses, clean-shaven, wearing a muted gray-brown T-shirt. He sits on the edge of a narrow single bed in a cramped rented room, phone at his ear, expression uncomfortable and sympathetic. Show cramped geometry clearly: the bed occupies most of the room width, a small desk and chair immediately beside it, a few shelves, a couple of moving boxes and personal belongings, little clear floor space. Modest lived-in room, not filthy, not a luxury apartment and not a caricature. A small soft desk lamp gives restrained warm light; gray-beige walls and slate shadows. His face, hairline, glasses and clothes must be distinct from BOTH protagonist and family colleague.
